name: DiffSplat
definition: A method that natively generates 3D Gaussian splats by fine-tuning a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model, exploiting web-scale 2D priors while keeping 3D consistency. Uses a lightweight reconstruction model to bootstrap multi-view Gaussian-splat grids for dataset curation and a 3D rendering loss for cross-view coherence.
summary: DiffSplat natively generates 3D Gaussian splats from text or images in one to two seconds by fine-tuning a diffusion model to exploit 2D priors while enforcing 3D consistency.
